description: Main window: only the core calls the frontend makes. Event listening for the close guard and the before-exit event (src/ui/shell/session.ts); dragging and double-click zooming through the data-tauri-drag-region top bar (the macOS title bar is an overlay); destroying the window once the close handler has saved pending edits; and the devtools hotkey, a command that exists in debug builds only. No fs, dialog or opener permissions: the frontend reaches files only through Wajha's own commands, which Tauri allows for the app's local pages by default. src-tauri/src/lib.rs tests that everything else is refused.
